slides.title: Images as Arrays
slides.content:
# Computer Vision 👁️

OpenCV (`cv2`) reads images as NumPy arrays of BGR (Blue-Green-Red) pixels.

```opencv
import cv2

# Read image (0 = Grayscale, 1 = Color)
img = cv2.imread('logo.png', 1)

# Display
cv2.imshow('Window', img)
cv2.waitKey(0) # Wait key press
cv2.destroyAllWindows()
```

slides.title: Image Processing
slides.content:
# Modifying Pixels 🖌️

## Resizing
```opencv
resized = cv2.resize(img, (100, 100))
```

## Color Conversion
Often convert BGR to Grayscale for processing.
```opencv
gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
```

## Blurring (Smoothing)
Reduces noise.
```opencv
blurred = cv2.GaussianBlur(img, (5, 5), 0)
```

slides.title: Video Capture
slides.content:
# Webcam Access 📹

```opencv
cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0) # 0 is default webcam

while True:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    cv2.imshow('Webcam', frame)
    if cv2.waitKey(1) == ord('q'):
        break

cap.release()
```
